en.title: Zelda 40th Anniversary Collection Restocks Confirmed for UK
en.summary: Fans who missed out on the highly sought-after Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Collection can rejoice, as Nintendo has confirmed upcoming restocks. The special edition console, featuring Triforce designs and green-and-gold Joy-Cons, initially sold out rapidly worldwide.
en.body:
The echo of Hyrule's 40th anniversary celebrations continues as **Nintendo** has officially confirmed that restocks for the coveted **Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Collection** are on the way. This news will undoubtedly be music to the ears of countless fans who were left disappointed when the limited-edition console and its accompanying accessories sold out almost instantly across the globe.

The collection, which launched on October 29th, features a striking design inspired by the **Triforce**, complete with distinctive green-and-gold Joy-Con controllers and a matching Zelda-themed dock. The console itself boasts special anniversary branding, making it a must-have for collectors and long-time devotees of the legendary franchise. The initial price point was set at $519.99, a premium that many were willing to pay for a piece of gaming history.

## A Second Chance for Triforce Hunters

While the initial rollout saw items vanish from virtual shelves in mere moments, **Nintendo** has now acknowledged the immense demand. In an update specifically targeting the UK market, a message on the official Nintendo Store page confirms that more stock is being prepared. This move is a welcome one, demonstrating **Nintendo**'s responsiveness to fan desire and ensuring that the celebration of **The Legend of Zelda's** 40 years of adventure reaches a wider audience. The announcement was made via the **Nintendo** Store app, a platform **Nintendo** is leveraging for future updates on availability.

This restock is particularly significant given the rapid sell-out of other anniversary merchandise, including special-edition **Switch Pro Controllers** and various other themed items. The fervor surrounding the **Zelda** franchise remains as potent as ever, with fans eager to commemorate its enduring legacy. The promise of more consoles means that the opportunity to own a tangible piece of this milestone is not entirely lost for those who acted fast or were perhaps too late to the party.

## What's Next for Zelda Fans

While the immediate focus is on replenishing stock for the 40th Anniversary Collection, rumors continue to swirl about further **Zelda**-themed releases. Speculation points towards a potential **Legend of Zelda Ultimate 40th Anniversary Edition** arriving as early as December 2026, which might bundle together several iconic adventures. For now, fans in the UK should keep a close eye on the **Nintendo Store** app for specific restock dates and purchasing information. Details regarding restocks in other regions have not yet been announced.
